name: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd.
summary: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in mining activities in Japan, rest of Asia, South America, and internationally. It operates through Resources Business, Machinery and Environmental Business, Real Estate Business, and Renewable Energy Business segments.
